WITH candidates AS (
 (SELECT f.id,f.day FROM statarena_app.fixtures f WHERE f.season=$1 AND f.league_id=$2  ORDER BY f.day NULLS LAST,f.id LIMIT ($3::int+1))
 UNION ALL (SELECT m.id,m.day FROM statarena_app.matches m WHERE m.season=$1 AND m.league_id=$2 
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.fixtures f WHERE f.id=m.id AND f.season=m.season AND f.league_id=m.league_id)
 ORDER BY m.day NULLS LAST,m.id LIMIT ($3::int+1))),
 keys AS (SELECT * FROM candidates ORDER BY day NULLS LAST,id LIMIT ($3::int+1)), page AS (SELECT id FROM keys ORDER BY day NULLS LAST,id LIMIT $3)
 SELECT s.*, (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT id,day::text FROM keys ORDER BY day NULLS LAST,id) r) keys,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT m.* FROM statarena_app.matches m JOIN page USING(id) ORDER BY m.day NULLS LAST,m.id) r) matches,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT f.* FROM statarena_app.fixtures f JOIN page USING(id) ORDER BY f.day NULLS LAST,f.id) r) fixtures,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT a.*,p.name,p.image_url,(SELECT json_object_agg(metric_key,value) FROM statarena_app.appearance_metrics e WHERE e.appearance_id=a.id) extras FROM statarena_app.appearances a JOIN statarena_app.players p ON p.id=a.player_ref WHERE a.match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page) ORDER BY a.match_id,a.ordinal,a.id) r) appearances,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.shots WHERE match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page) ORDER BY match_id,ordinal,id) r) shots,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.team_statistics WHERE match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page) ORDER BY match_id,ordinal) r) stats,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.match_coverage WHERE match_id IN (SELECT id FROM page)) r) cover,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT match_id,appearance_id FROM statarena_app.match_appearance_members WHERE match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page) ORDER BY match_id,ordinal) r) players,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.match_warnings WHERE match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page) ORDER BY ordinal) r) warnings,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT m.metric_key AS key,m.label,m.unit,m.decimals FROM statarena_app.partition_metrics pm JOIN statarena_app.metric_definitions m USING(metric_key) WHERE pm.season=$1 AND pm.league_id=$2 ORDER BY pm.ordinal) r) metrics,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT c.*,s.season,s.sample_matches,(SELECT json_agg(native_season ORDER BY ordinal) FROM statarena_app.competition_catalog_seasons k WHERE k.competition_id=c.id) catalog_seasons FROM statarena_app.competitions c JOIN statarena_app.competition_seasons s ON s.competition_id=c.id WHERE c.id=$2 AND s.season=$1) r) competitions,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT s.team_id AS id,s.name,s.image_url,s.sample_matches,t.country FROM statarena_app.team_seasons s JOIN statarena_app.teams t ON s.team_id=t.id WHERE season=$1 AND league_id=$2 ORDER BY s.team_id) r) teams,
 (SELECT json_object_agg(metric_key,value) FROM statarena_app.partition_counts WHERE season=$1 AND league_id=$2) counts,
 (SELECT json_agg(note ORDER BY ordinal) FROM statarena_app.partition_notes WHERE season=$1 AND league_id=$2) notes FROM (SELECT p.*,source_digest AS version, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.publication_jobs j WHERE j.season=p.season AND j.league_id=p.league_id) dirty FROM statarena_app.partitions p WHERE season=$1 AND league_id=$2) s
